q: The photo of my bill is blurred and the units are unreadable. What should I do?
title: Blurred bill photo: what to do
short: Do not guess the number. Download a fresh copy from your DISCOM or supplier portal, ask the supplier for a duplicate, or read the meter history. A guessed figure is the first thing a verifier challenges, and one wrong digit can move a month by thousands of kWh.

sections.h: Where to get a clean copy
ul: Most DISCOMs let you download past bills by consumer number.
Fuel and gas suppliers reissue invoices on request.
Your meter reading history or the bill's QR code.

p: Lay the bill flat in daylight, fill the frame and keep the units, dates and consumer number sharp.

senseible: Senseible flags fields it cannot read clearly instead of filling them in, so a gap stays visible until you supply a clean copy.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements (iso.org)
